senses.en: a substitute, especially a person acting in place of another
acting as a substitute

ex.en: The aunt became a surrogate mother to the orphaned children.
ex.zh: 這位阿姨成了那些孤兒的代理母親。

parts.m: in place of 代替（= sub-）

root.note: 被要求來頂替的人 → 代理人

senses.en: to be all around something or someone

ex.en: Tall mountains surround the quiet village on every side.
ex.zh: 高山從四面八方環繞著這個寧靜的村莊。

senses.en: a person who measures and examines land or buildings

ex.en: The surveyor marked the exact boundary between the two farms.
ex.zh: 測量員標出了兩座農場之間的確切界線。

root.note: 從上方察看的人 → 測量員

senses.en: the state of being easily affected or harmed by something
senses.zh: 易受影響（感染）的程度；敏感性

ex.en: Lack of sleep increases your susceptibility to colds.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會讓你更容易感冒。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 容易接受（外來影響）→ 易感性

senses.en: likely to be influenced or harmed by something

ex.en: Young children are especially susceptible to this virus.
ex.zh: 幼童特別容易感染這種病毒。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 容易接受（外來影響）→ 易受影響的

mn: 常用片語 be susceptible to（容易受到…）。

senses.en: a feeling of excited or anxious uncertainty about what will happen

ex.en: The movie kept the audience in suspense until the very last scene.
ex.zh: 這部電影讓觀眾一直懸著心，直到最後一幕。

root.note: 懸在半空中 → 懸念

senses.en: the temporary stopping or delaying of something
a temporary removal from a job, school, or team as punishment
the system of springs that supports a vehicle

ex.en: The player received a two-game suspension for fighting.
ex.zh: 這名球員因打架被禁賽兩場。

root.note: 掛起來、懸而不動 → 暫停

senses.en: having a feeling that something is wrong or someone is dishonest
causing a feeling that something is wrong

ex.en: Please report any suspicious package to the security desk.
ex.zh: 如有可疑包裹，請通報保全櫃檯。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 從底下偷偷往上看 → 懷疑的

senses.en: food and drink that keep someone alive
the act of maintaining or supporting something

ex.en: The stranded hikers relied on berries for sustenance.
ex.zh: 受困的登山客靠吃莓果維生。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 從下方撐住生命 → 食物、營養

senses.en: having a dark or sunburned complexion

ex.en: The old fisherman had a swarthy face from years at sea.
ex.zh: 老漁夫因長年出海而有一張黝黑的臉。

senses.en: a person who is devoted to luxury and pleasure
senses.zh: 貪圖享樂的人；奢侈逸樂者

ex.en: A true Sybarite, he refused to travel anywhere without a private chef.
ex.zh: 他是個十足的享樂主義者，沒有私人廚師就不肯出門旅行。

parts.m: 古希臘城市名，以奢華聞名

root.note: 錫巴里斯城的居民以奢侈著稱 → 貪圖享樂的人

senses.en: relating to or based on syllables
(of a consonant) forming a syllable by itself

ex.en: Japanese kana is a syllabic writing system, not an alphabet.
ex.zh: 日文假名是一種音節文字，而不是字母系統。

root.note: 合在一起唸的音 → 音節的

senses.en: the division of words into syllables

ex.en: Dictionaries use dots to show the syllabication of each word.
ex.zh: 字典用圓點標示每個字的音節劃分。

root.note: 把字切成一個個音節 → 音節劃分

senses.en: a unit of pronunciation with one vowel sound

ex.en: In the word "banana," the stress falls on the second syllable.
ex.zh: banana 這個字的重音落在第二個音節。

root.note: 合在一起唸的一組音 → 音節

senses.en: an outline of the topics covered in a course

ex.en: The professor handed out the syllabus on the first day of class.
ex.zh: 教授在第一天上課時發下課程大綱。

senses.en: an imaginary spirit of the air
a slender, graceful woman or girl

ex.en: The ballerina moved across the stage like a sylph.
ex.zh: 那位芭蕾舞者像精靈般在舞台上飄移。

senses.en: having matching parts on both sides of a line or center

ex.en: A butterfly's wings are almost perfectly symmetrical.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀幾乎完全對稱。

parts.m: together, same 一起、相同（= syn-）

root.note: 兩邊量起來一樣 → 對稱的

senses.en: the quality of having parts that match exactly on both sides
pleasing balance and proportion

ex.en: The architect admired the perfect symmetry of the ancient temple.
ex.zh: 建築師讚嘆這座古廟完美的對稱。

parts.m: together, same 一起、相同（= syn-）

root.note: 兩邊量起來一樣 → 對稱

senses.en: feeling or showing concern for someone else's suffering
showing approval of or support for an idea

ex.en: My teacher was sympathetic when I explained why my essay was late.
ex.zh: 我解釋作文遲交的原因時，老師很體諒我。

root.note: 和別人有相同的感受 → 同情的

mn: 注意：sympathetic 不是「令人好感的」，那是 likable。

senses.en: to feel or express sorrow for someone's trouble
to agree with or support an opinion

ex.en: I sympathize with anyone who has to commute two hours a day.
ex.zh: 我很同情每天通勤要兩小時的人。

root.note: 感同身受 → 同情

senses.en: relating to or having the form of a symphony

ex.en: The band recorded a symphonic version of their greatest hits.
ex.zh: 這個樂團錄製了他們暢銷金曲的交響樂版本。

root.note: 各種聲音合在一起 → 交響樂的

senses.en: harmonious in sound

ex.en: The choir's voices blended into one symphonious sound.
ex.zh: 合唱團的歌聲融合成和諧悅耳的樂音。

root.note: 聲音合在一起很協調 → 和諧的

senses.en: a long piece of music for a full orchestra
a harmonious combination of elements

ex.en: The orchestra performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony to a sold-out hall.
ex.zh: 管弦樂團在座無虛席的音樂廳演奏貝多芬第九號交響曲。

root.note: 各種聲音合在一起 → 交響曲

senses.en: the fact of happening at the same time
a chronological arrangement of events side by side

ex.en: Engineers worked to keep the two motors in perfect synchronism.
ex.zh: 工程師設法讓兩部馬達保持完全同步。

root.note: 在相同的時間 → 同時發生

senses.en: a group of people or companies working together for a shared business purpose
[ˋsɪndɪˏket] to sell articles, shows, or other content to many outlets at once
senses.zh: （將文章、節目）同時賣給多家媒體

ex.en: A syndicate of investors bought the struggling football club.
ex.zh: 一個投資財團買下了這家經營困難的足球俱樂部。

parts.m: judge, justice 審判、正義（希臘文 dikē）

root.note: 原指一起處理事務的代表 → 聯合組織

senses.en: the contraction of two vowels or syllables into one
the separation of liquid from a gel

ex.en: In poetry, syneresis can squeeze two syllables into one to fit the meter.
ex.zh: 詩中常用元音縮合，把兩個音節擠成一個以配合格律。

root.note: 拿在一起合併 → 縮合

senses.en: an official meeting of church leaders

ex.en: The bishops gathered in Rome for a synod on family life.
ex.zh: 主教們齊聚羅馬，召開有關家庭生活的宗教會議。

root.note: 走到一起來開會 → 宗教會議

senses.en: a word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another

ex.en: "Happy" is a common synonym for "glad."
ex.zh: happy 是 glad 的一個常見同義字。

root.note: 相同意思的名稱 → 同義字

senses.en: a brief summary of a book, film, or subject

ex.en: Read the synopsis on the back cover before choosing a novel.
ex.zh: 挑小說前先讀一下封底的內容簡介。

root.note: 一眼看到全貌 → 摘要

senses.en: done according to a fixed plan or method

ex.en: The detectives made a systematic search of the entire building.
ex.zh: 警探們對整棟大樓進行了有系統的搜查。

root.note: 放在一起組成整體 → 有系統的

senses.en: a group of models or motionless figures representing a scene
senses.zh: （由人扮演的）靜態畫面；活人畫

senses.en: a striking scene or picture

ex.en: The students posed in a tableau of the signing of the Constitution.
ex.zh: 學生們擺出簽署憲法的靜態畫面。

root.note: 一小幅畫 → 靜態畫面

senses.en: habitually saying very little

ex.en: The taciturn farmer answered every question with a single word.
ex.zh: 那位沉默寡言的農夫每個問題都只用一個字回答。

parts.m: be silent 沉默（拉丁文 tacere）

root.note: 習慣保持沉默 → 寡言的

mn: 與 tacit（心照不宣的）同字根，都跟「不說出口」有關。

senses.en: a small, sharp nail with a broad head
a course of action or approach
to fasten with tacks; to add something as an extra

ex.en: When friendly requests failed, the landlord tried a different tack.
ex.zh: 好言相勸沒用之後，房東換了一種做法。

senses.en: skill in dealing with people or difficult situations without offending

ex.en: It takes tact to tell a friend that her singing is off-key.
ex.zh: 要告訴朋友她唱歌走音，得講得很得體才行。

root.note: 對人事有敏銳的觸感 → 圓滑得體

mn: 不要和 tactic（策略）搞混：tact 是說話做事得體。

senses.en: a person skilled in planning tactics

ex.en: The coach was a brilliant tactician who always found an opponent's weakness.
ex.zh: 這位教練是傑出的戰術家，總能找到對手的弱點。

root.note: 擅長安排部署的人 → 戰術家

senses.en: actions carefully planned to achieve a specific goal
the art of arranging forces in battle

ex.en: The company used aggressive sales tactics to attract new customers.
ex.zh: 這家公司用強勢的銷售手法吸引新客戶。

root.note: 安排部署的技術 → 戰術

senses.en: the state of touching at a single point without crossing

ex.en: The point of tangency is where the line just touches the circle.
ex.zh: 切點就是直線恰好碰到圓的地方。

root.note: 剛好碰觸 → 相切

senses.en: a sudden change of subject in speech or thought
a straight line that touches a curve at one point

ex.en: The lecture went off on a tangent about the professor's cat.
ex.zh: 這堂課突然岔題去講教授的貓了。

root.note: 只碰一下就離開的線 → 切線；話題一碰就岔開 → 離題

mn: 片語 go off on a tangent：講話突然離題。

senses.en: able to be touched; physical
clear and definite; real

ex.en: The new policy has produced tangible results in just six months.
ex.zh: 新政策在短短六個月內就產生了具體成效。

root.note: 能摸得到 → 有形的、具體的

senses.en: a place where animal skins are made into leather

ex.en: The old tannery by the river gave off a terrible smell.
ex.zh: 河邊那間老製革廠散發出難聞的臭味。

root.note: 鞣製皮革的地方 → 製革廠

senses.en: to tease or torment with something desired but kept out of reach

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread seemed to tantalize the hungry students.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓飢腸轆轆的學生們心癢難耐。

parts.m: 坦塔洛斯（希臘神話人物）

root.note: 坦塔洛斯受罰站在水中，水果與水都碰不到 → 可望而不可及

senses.en: equivalent in effect or seriousness to

ex.en: Staying silent about the fraud would be tantamount to approving it.
ex.zh: 對這樁詐欺保持沉默，就等於是贊同它。

parts.m: so much 那麼多（拉丁文 tantus）

root.note: 數量達到那麼多 → 等同於

mn: 幾乎都用 be tantamount to（等於…）。

senses.en: a heavy cloth with pictures or designs woven into it
a complex and varied combination of things

ex.en: The city is a rich tapestry of cultures and languages.
ex.zh: 這座城市是由多元文化和語言交織而成的豐富織錦。

senses.en: to damage someone's reputation
to make or become dull and discolored

ex.en: One scandal can tarnish a company's image for years.
ex.zh: 一件醜聞就可能讓公司的形象蒙塵好幾年。

senses.en: stretched or pulled tight
tense or anxious; (of writing) concise and controlled
senses.zh: 緊張的；（文筆）簡潔緊湊的

ex.en: Pull the rope taut before you tie the knot.
ex.zh: 打結之前先把繩子拉緊。

mn: taut 和 taunt（嘲弄）只差一個 n，別搞混。

senses.en: the system by which a government collects money through taxes

ex.en: The colonists protested taxation without representation.
ex.zh: 殖民地居民抗議「無代表權卻被課稅」。

root.note: 課稅的制度 → 稅制

senses.en: the art of preserving and stuffing the skins of dead animals

ex.en: The museum displays owls and foxes preserved through taxidermy.
ex.zh: 博物館展示以剝製術保存的貓頭鷹和狐狸。

root.note: 把皮整理擺好 → 標本剝製術

senses.en: technique or technical method (older use)
technical

ex.en: The old manual described the technic of casting bronze bells.
ex.zh: 那本舊手冊描述了鑄造青銅鐘的技術。

root.note: 技藝的 → 技術

senses.en: a small detail of a rule or law, especially one that affects the outcome
senses.zh: （法律、規則上的）細節；技術性問題

senses.en: the use of technical terms or methods

ex.en: The suspect was released on a technicality because the warrant was dated wrong.
ex.zh: 由於搜索票日期寫錯，嫌犯因程序上的細節而獲釋。

root.note: 技術層面的細節 → 技術性問題

senses.en: a particular way of doing something that requires skill

ex.en: The swimmer improved her breathing technique before the race.
ex.zh: 這位泳者在比賽前改進了她的換氣技巧。

root.note: 做事的技藝 → 技巧

senses.en: the description of the arts and crafts of different peoples

ex.en: Her book on technography compares weaving methods across the Pacific islands.
ex.zh: 她那本工藝誌比較了太平洋各島嶼的編織方法。

root.note: 記錄各地技藝 → 工藝誌

senses.en: the use of scientific knowledge for practical purposes; machines and equipment developed this way

ex.en: New technology has changed the way students take notes in class.
ex.zh: 新科技改變了學生上課做筆記的方式。

root.note: 研究技藝的學問 → 科技

senses.en: to be full of or swarming with
(of rain) to pour down heavily

ex.en: During summer, the pond will teem with frogs and dragonflies.
ex.zh: 夏天時，池塘裡會到處都是青蛙和蜻蜓。

mn: 常用 teem with（充滿），別和 team（隊伍）搞混。

senses.en: communication of thoughts directly from one mind to another

ex.en: The twins joked that they could communicate by telepathy.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎開玩笑說他們能用心電感應溝通。

root.note: 遠距離感受到對方 → 心電感應

senses.en: the technology of transmitting voice over a distance

ex.en: Internet telephony lets people make calls without a landline.
ex.zh: 網路電話技術讓人不需要市話也能打電話。

root.note: 把聲音傳到遠方 → 電話通訊

senses.en: an instrument that makes distant objects appear larger
to shorten or compress

ex.en: Through the telescope, we could see the rings of Saturn.
ex.zh: 透過望遠鏡，我們看得到土星環。

root.note: 看遠方的工具 → 望遠鏡

senses.en: revealing something that is meant to be hidden
senses.zh: 暴露真相的；露出馬腳的

senses.en: a person who reveals secrets; a sign that reveals something

ex.en: Chocolate on his face was a telltale sign that he had eaten the cake.
ex.zh: 他臉上的巧克力，洩露了他偷吃蛋糕的事實。

senses.en: excessive confidence or boldness; nerve

ex.en: The intern had the temerity to correct the CEO in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 那個實習生竟敢當眾糾正執行長。

parts.m: rashly 輕率地（拉丁文 temere）

root.note: 輕率的態度 → 魯莽

mn: 常用 have the temerity to do（竟敢做…）。

senses.en: relating to time
relating to worldly rather than spiritual affairs
relating to the temples of the head

ex.en: The medieval pope held both spiritual and temporal power.
ex.zh: 中世紀的教宗同時握有宗教與世俗的權力。

root.note: 屬於時間（而非永恆）的 → 時間的、世俗的

senses.en: lasting for only a limited time

ex.en: The road closure is only temporary while workers repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 道路封閉只是暫時的，工人正在修橋。

root.note: 只在一段時間內 → 暫時的

senses.en: to avoid making a decision in order to gain time

ex.en: The mayor tried to temporize until after the election.
ex.zh: 市長試圖拖延，等到選後再說。

root.note: 在時間上打轉 → 拖延

senses.en: to make someone want to do something, especially something unwise
to attract or persuade

ex.en: Don't tempt me with dessert while I'm on a diet.
ex.zh: 我在節食，別拿甜點誘惑我。

senses.en: a person or thing that tempts; (the Tempter) the Devil

ex.en: In the story, the tempter offers the hero riches in exchange for his soul.
ex.zh: 故事中，誘惑者用財富換取主角的靈魂。

senses.en: holding firmly to something; not giving up easily
keeping a firm hold

ex.en: The tenacious reporter kept digging until she uncovered the truth.
ex.zh: 那位鍥而不捨的記者一直追查，直到揭露真相。

root.note: 緊緊抓住不放 → 頑強的

senses.en: a person who rents land or a building from a landlord

ex.en: The new tenant signed a one-year lease on the apartment.
ex.zh: 新房客簽了一年的公寓租約。

root.note: 持有（租用）房產的人 → 房客

senses.en: an inclination to behave or develop in a certain way

ex.en: He has a tendency to talk too fast when he is nervous.
ex.zh: 他一緊張就容易講話太快。

root.note: 朝某方向伸展 → 傾向

senses.en: a principle or belief held by a group

ex.en: Freedom of speech is a basic tenet of democracy.
ex.zh: 言論自由是民主的基本信條。

parts.m: 拉丁文動詞變化（他持有）

root.note: 大家所持有的信念 → 信條

senses.en: the general meaning or character of something
the highest ordinary adult male singing voice

ex.en: The overall tenor of the meeting was surprisingly positive.
ex.zh: 整場會議的基調出乎意料地正面。

root.note: 貫串始終、持守的方向 → 要旨；歌曲中持守主旋律的聲部 → 男高音

senses.en: nervous and unable to relax; stretched tight
a verb form showing the time of an action
to make or become tight

ex.en: The room was tense as everyone waited for the results.
ex.zh: 大家等著結果時，房間裡氣氛很緊張。

root.note: 被拉緊的 → 緊張的

senses.en: not certain or fixed; provisional
done without confidence; hesitant

ex.en: We made tentative plans to meet next Friday.
ex.zh: 我們暫定下星期五見面。

root.note: 只是嘗試性的 → 暫定的

senses.en: the period during which someone holds an office or position
a permanent position, especially for a professor

ex.en: During her tenure as principal, test scores rose steadily.
ex.zh: 在她擔任校長期間，考試成績穩定上升。

root.note: 持有職位的期間 → 任期

senses.en: a three-hundredth anniversary

ex.en: The university held a festival to mark its tercentenary.
ex.zh: 這所大學舉辦慶典，紀念創校三百週年。

root.note: 三個一百年 → 三百週年

senses.en: a harsh, bad-tempered woman

ex.en: In the old comedy, the hero's mother-in-law is portrayed as a termagant.
ex.zh: 在那齣老喜劇裡，主角的岳母被描寫成一個悍婦。

senses.en: (of a disease) leading to death; at the end
a station at the end of a transport route; a building at an airport
a device for entering data into a computer

ex.en: Our flight leaves from Terminal 2, so we should hurry.
ex.zh: 我們的班機從第二航廈出發，得快一點。

root.note: 在終點的 → 末期的、終點站

senses.en: to bring to an end or come to an end
to dismiss from a job

ex.en: Either side may terminate the contract with thirty days' notice.
ex.zh: 任何一方只要提前三十天通知，就可以終止合約。

root.note: 使到達終點 → 終止

senses.en: the act of bringing something to an end
dismissal from a job

ex.en: The termination of the project left twenty engineers without work.
ex.zh: 這項計畫終止後，二十名工程師失去了工作。

root.note: 到達終點 → 終止

senses.en: the final stop at the end of a railway or bus route
an end point or goal

ex.en: We stayed on the train until it reached the terminus.
ex.zh: 我們一直坐到火車抵達終點站。

root.note: 路線的盡頭 → 終點站

senses.en: to make someone extremely frightened

ex.en: Loud thunder can terrify young dogs.
ex.zh: 響雷可能會把幼犬嚇壞。

root.note: 使人害怕 → 嚇壞

senses.en: relating to the ownership of land or sea areas
(of animals or people) defending an area against others
senses.zh: 有地盤意識的；護地盤的

ex.en: The two countries have a long-running territorial dispute over the islands.
ex.zh: 兩國對這些島嶼有長期的領土爭議。

root.note: 屬於某片土地的 → 領土的

senses.en: using few words, often in a way that seems rude
senses.zh: 簡短的；（態度）冷淡簡慢的

ex.en: Her terse reply made it clear she did not want to talk.
ex.zh: 她簡短的回答清楚表示她不想談。

parts.m: wiped, polished 擦淨（拉丁文 tergere）

root.note: 擦得乾乾淨淨、沒有多餘 → 簡潔的

senses.en: something that serves as clear proof of a fact or quality
a will stating how a person's property is to be divided
(Testament) either of the two main parts of the Bible

ex.en: The bridge still standing after the earthquake is a testament to good engineering.
ex.zh: 這座橋在地震後依然屹立，證明了工程品質優良。

root.note: 見證下所立的東西 → 證明、遺囑

mn: 常用 be a testament to（是…的證明）。

senses.en: a person who has made a will

ex.en: The testator left most of his fortune to a local hospital.
ex.zh: 立遺囑人把大部分財產留給了當地一家醫院。

root.note: 在見證下立遺囑的人 → 立遺囑人

senses.en: a formal statement praising someone's character or a product's quality
a gift or event honoring someone's service

ex.en: Her former coach wrote a glowing testimonial for her college application.
ex.zh: 她以前的教練為她的大學申請寫了一封熱情洋溢的推薦函。

root.note: 為某人某物作見證 → 推薦、證言

senses.en: rule by a god or gods; a system of gods ranked in order
senses.zh: 神權統治；諸神的階級體系

ex.en: Ancient Greek thearchy placed Zeus at the head of all the gods.
ex.zh: 古希臘的諸神體系把宙斯置於眾神之首。

root.note: 由神統治 → 神權政治

senses.en: belief in the existence of a god or gods, especially one creator

ex.en: The philosophy class debated the arguments for theism and atheism.
ex.zh: 哲學課上辯論了有神論與無神論的論點。

root.note: 相信神的主義 → 有神論

senses.en: a system of government in which religious leaders rule in the name of God

ex.en: In a theocracy, religious law is also the law of the state.
ex.zh: 在神權國家中，宗教律法也就是國家的法律。

root.note: 以神之名統治 → 神權政治

senses.en: a mixing of different gods or forms of worship
mystical union of the soul with God

ex.en: Roman theocrasy blended local gods with the gods of conquered peoples.
ex.zh: 羅馬的諸神混合崇拜把本地神祇與被征服民族的神祇融合在一起。

root.note: 把各種神混合起來 → 諸神混合崇拜

mn: 與 theocracy（神權政治）只差字母順序：crasy 是混合，cracy 是統治。

senses.en: a person who studies religion and religious beliefs

ex.en: The theologian wrote a book on the meaning of forgiveness.
ex.zh: 這位神學家寫了一本探討寬恕意義的書。

root.note: 研究神的學者 → 神學家

senses.en: relating to the study of religion

ex.en: He spent three years at a theological seminary before becoming a pastor.
ex.zh: 他在神學院讀了三年後才成為牧師。

root.note: 關於神的學問的 → 神學的

senses.en: the study of the nature of God and religious belief
a particular system of religious beliefs

ex.en: She majored in theology and later taught world religions.
ex.zh: 她主修神學，後來教授世界宗教。

root.note: 研究神的學問 → 神學

senses.en: based on theory rather than practice or experience
possible in principle but not yet proven

ex.en: The danger is only theoretical, since no such accident has ever happened.
ex.zh: 這種危險只是理論上的，因為從來沒發生過這類事故。

parts.m: look at, contemplate 觀看、思考

root.note: 只在思考層面上的 → 理論的

senses.en: a person who develops or studies theories

ex.en: A political theorist argued that power always seeks to expand.
ex.zh: 一位政治理論家主張權力總是尋求擴張。

root.note: 建構理論的人 → 理論家

senses.en: to form a theory or ideas about something

ex.en: Scientists theorize that the crater was formed by a meteor.
ex.zh: 科學家推論這個坑洞是隕石撞擊所形成。

root.note: 形成理論 → 推論

senses.en: near that place, time, number, or amount

ex.en: The ship sank off the coast of Maine or thereabout.
ex.zh: 那艘船在緬因州外海或其附近沉沒。

mn: 較常見的形式是 thereabouts，常用 or thereabouts（…左右）。

senses.en: (formal, legal) for that; for it

ex.en: The tenant broke the window and must pay the landlord therefor.
ex.zh: 房客打破了窗戶，必須為此賠償房東。

mn: 不要和 therefore（因此）混淆：therefor 少一個 e，意思是「為此」。

senses.en: relating to heat
(of clothing) designed to keep the body warm
a rising current of warm air

ex.en: Iceland uses thermal energy from volcanoes to heat homes.
ex.zh: 冰島利用火山的熱能為住宅供暖。

root.note: 與熱有關的 → 熱的

senses.en: producing electricity from a difference in temperature

ex.en: The probe uses a thermoelectric generator to power its instruments in deep space.
ex.zh: 這艘探測器在深太空中以熱電發電機為儀器供電。

root.note: 由熱產生電的 → 熱電的

senses.en: electricity produced directly from heat, as by a temperature difference between two metals

ex.en: Researchers hope thermoelectricity can turn waste heat from cars into useful power.
ex.zh: 研究人員希望熱電技術能把汽車的廢熱轉換為可用的電力。

root.note: 由熱產生的電 → 熱電

senses.en: a statement or theory put forward and supported by argument
a long essay written for a university degree

ex.en: Every good essay begins with a clear thesis statement.
ex.zh: 每篇好文章都從一個清楚的論點陳述開始。

parts.m: put, place 放置（希臘文 tithenai）

root.note: 提出來放在桌上的主張 → 論點

senses.en: a horse of a pure breed, especially one used for racing
of pure breed; (of a person) well-bred and first-class
senses.zh: 純種的；教養良好的；一流的

ex.en: The thoroughbred won the race by three full lengths.
ex.zh: 那匹純種賽馬以整整三個馬身的差距贏得比賽。
